summary.one_liner: MacPass is an open-source, native macOS client for the KeePass password manager database format.
summary.what_it_does: MacPass is a KeePass-compatible password manager client for macOS, described by its author as a feature-complete KeePass client with a polished interface. The README says it is the only native macOS client that is fully open source. It supports a plugin system, with plugins checked for signatures before loading and settings for unsigned or incompatible plugins. Pre-built releases are published on GitHub, and there is an unsigned continuous build of the latest changes. The README includes build instructions using Carthage and xcodebuild, and a security notice asking users to update to version 0.8.2 or later and to only use releases from the official GitHub page. It also lists KeePassX/KeePassXC, KyPass Companion and KeeWeb as alternatives.
use_cases: Open and manage KeePass password databases on a Mac
Use a native macOS password manager instead of a browser or Electron app
Build MacPass from source for development
Contribute bug fixes or localization to an open-source macOS app
Install KeePass plugins with signature checking
how_to_run: Open the project in Xcode and build and run
xcodebuild -scheme MacPass -target MacPass -configuration Release CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO NO_SPARKLE=NO_SPARKLE
notable: Only native macOS KeePass client the author states is fully open source
Plugin system with signature checks and settings to control loading of unsigned or incompatible plugins
Unsigned continuous build available for the latest changes
Based on earlier projects including KeePassKit and MiniKeePass
caveats: Not distributed on the Mac App Store because the GPLv3 license is incompatible with its terms
Version 0.8 requires macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later; older versions need earlier macOS releases
The README notes the project had a period of slow updates, and the continuous build may be unstable
The official website was dropped; releases should only be taken from the GitHub page
